place.title: Place {ref} (vibration motor module)
place.text: Push {ref}'s 3 pins into column f, one pin per row: IN into hole {hole.in}, VCC into {hole.vcc} and GND into {hole.gnd}. The round motor faces up.
place.tip: Read the labels printed next to the pins. If yours are in another order, follow the labels, not the picture.

why: {ref} is a small coin motor with an off-centre weight: it buzzes and shakes while it runs. The transistor on the module switches it, so the Pico pin only gives the signal.

wire.ground: This connects {ref}'s GND pin to ground.
wire.power: This powers {ref}'s motor from 3.3 V (it shakes a bit less than on 5 V, but never puts 5 V near the Pico).
wire.out: {pin} switches {ref}: 1 runs the motor, 0 stops it.
